# Parley v0.1.3

Parley is a native macOS workbench for visible, supervised collaboration
between the AI coding CLIs you already use. This beta completes the current
public-release readiness arc while keeping every model call inside the user's
signed-in Claude Code, Codex, Agy or GitHub Copilot CLI.

## Highlights

### Safer shared context

- Reviewed context packs now have a transactional draft lifecycle, bounded
  size, explicit cancellation and trusted human capture paths.
- Large context packs avoid repeated full-payload work while editing.
- Vendor-owned browser and tool evidence carries explicit capability and
  provenance information before it can enter an editable context pack.
- Pinned snippets and workspace briefs remain deliberate, reusable sources;
  agents cannot silently add repository content to a request.

### Portable cross-vendor workspaces

- Save portable team templates with stable roles, vendor choices and pane
  layouts, then recreate them in another folder without automatically starting
  agents.
- Move an exact live tmux pane between workspaces or clone its visible
  configuration as a fresh stopped placeholder, both through an explicit
  preview.
- Open folders through `parley open`, `parley://open`, Finder's Open With menu
  or the bundled Open in Parley service.
- Inspect Git worktrees without letting Parley create, delete or mutate them.

### VS Code companion

- The release includes `Parley-Companion-0.1.0.vsix`.
- Open the current VS Code workspace in Parley, add explicit editor sources to
  Parley's editable context preview, inspect content-free attention counts and
  focus an authoritative pane or record.
- The companion is a thin local control surface. It does not host agents,
  contain credentials or replace the native app.

### Collaboration visibility and recovery

- The Status Center now exposes protocol compatibility, agent readiness,
  delivery receipts, returned-result acknowledgement, core health and bounded
  collaboration history.
- History can be filtered, exported, retained or purged through explicit local
  controls.
- Vendor compatibility checks, core lifecycle recovery and update verification
  make stale panes and interrupted coordination visible instead of guessing
  from terminal output.
- Privacy-bounded feedback bundles can be reviewed before they leave the Mac.

### Open-source and packaging readiness

- Parley is now licensed under Apache License 2.0 with contribution, privacy,
  vulnerability-reporting and third-party notice documents.
- The macOS app and VS Code companion both carry the applicable licence and
  notice files.
- CI scans the complete reachable Git history for credentials and private
  artefacts, in addition to running the native, packaging and extension checks.
- Agent process trees retain Parley's mandatory macOS Seatbelt boundary, while
  vendor permission prompts remain visible and authoritative.

## Install and requirements

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- `tmux` and at least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.3-mac-arm64.dmg`, drag Parley to Applications, and use
  the first-run Environment Check to verify the local setup.
- The optional VS Code integration is installed separately from
  `Parley-Companion-0.1.0.vsix` using **Extensions → Install from VSIX…**.

This beta is ad-hoc signed with the hardened runtime and is **not notarized**.
macOS will identify it as software from an unidentified developer. After first
trying to open the app, use **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open
Anyway** only if the files came from this expected release. Never disable
Gatekeeper globally.

## Upgrade from v0.1.2

Quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in Applications, and reopen it. Workspace
tabs, tmux panes, context, layouts and collaboration history remain under
`~/Library/Application Support/Parley Native`. An idle older coordination core
is upgraded automatically; active Ask or Delegate work is allowed to finish
first and appears as **Core upgrade: pending** in Status.

## Verify the download

Use `Parley-0.1.3-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify the DMG, ZIP, release manifest,
install guide and VS Code companion before opening them. The release also
contains `Parley-0.1.3-mac-arm64.release.json`, which records the source commit,
platform and signing state.

The generated `Parley-0.1.3-mac-arm64-INSTALL.txt` contains the complete install,
upgrade, footprint and uninstall guide.
